title: From Twisted Facts to Rogue Agents: Can LLMs Reliably Detect Multi-Dimensional Hallucinations?
abstract: arXiv:2611.08231v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used for information access, content production, and agent-based task execution, but their outputs remain vulnerable to subtle, high-risk hallucinations. To systematically evaluate and advance post-generation hallucination detection, we introduce HaluCheck, a large-scale, bilingual benchmark comprising over 42k instances spanning both factual hallucinations in text and faithfulness hallucinations in agent trajectories. HaluCheck features fine-grained, multi-level annotations for detection, localization, and correction, covering different tasks and perturbation degrees. Experiments on fourteen LLMs reveal that, while models show basic sample-level detection ability, they struggle with fine-grained localization, correction, and agent hallucination detection. translated_title: 从扭曲的事实到失控的智能体：大语言模型能否可靠地检测多维幻觉？
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）被广泛应用于信息获取、内容生产和基于智能体的任务执行，但其输出仍然容易受到细微且高风险的幻觉影响。为了系统性评估并推动生成后幻觉检测的发展，我们提出了 HaluCheck，这是一个大规模双语基准，包含超过 42,000 个实例，涵盖文本中的事实性幻觉和智能体轨迹中的忠实性幻觉。HaluCheck 具有面向检测、定位和纠正的细粒度多层次标注，覆盖不同的任务和扰动程度。在十四个大语言模型上的实验表明，尽管模型展现出基本的样本级检测能力，但它们在细粒度定位、纠正以及智能体幻觉检测方面表现不佳。进一步的分析显示，思维推理、网络搜索和监督微调各自带来了部分改进，但没有一种方法能完全解决该问题。
tldr: 提出大规模双语幻觉检测基准 HaluCheck，涵盖文本事实性幻觉与智能体轨迹忠实性幻觉，揭示现有大语言模型虽具备基础检测能力，但在细粒度定位、纠正和智能体幻觉检测上仍存在显著不足。
en_tdlr: We introduce HaluCheck, a large-scale bilingual benchmark for multi-dimensional hallucination detection spanning factual hallucinations in text and faithfulness hallucinations in agent trajectories, revealing that current LLMs show only basic detection ability and struggle with fine-grained localization, correction, and agent hallucination detection.
